en: A sepia-toned photograph showing a religious procession on a cobblestone street in a European city. Women and girls dressed in white, possibly for First Communion or a Marian procession, walk in front of a statue of the Virgin Mary adorned with flowers. There are banners with religious imagery and a crowd of spectators, including some on horseback, lining the street. The architecture is ornate and suggests a historical European setting.
